summary: Check that a user is signed in

200.description: A session of a signed-in user is present; the answer has no body

description:
nginx asks this before it serves an admin page (the `auth_request` directive) and shows the page only when the answer is 200. The answer has no body: 200 for a signed-in session, 401 without a valid session, 403 for an API token. Scripts have no use for it.

Needs: a signed-in session (API tokens are refused)
